reference: The ocarina plays five notes, one per button: A = D4, C-down = F4, C-right = A4, C-left = B4, C-up = D5.
Song of Time: C-right, A, C-down, twice (A4 D4 F4, A4 D4 F4).
Song of Storms: A, C-down, C-up, twice (D4 F4 D5, twice).
Zelda's Lullaby: C-left, C-up, C-right, twice (B4 D5 A4, twice).
Epona's Song: C-up, C-left, C-right, twice (D5 B4 A4, twice).
Saria's Song: C-down, C-right, C-left, twice (F4 A4 B4, twice).
Sun's Song: C-right, C-down, C-up, twice (A4 F4 D5, twice).
The Ocarina of Time is a blue ocarina; young Link holds it in the Kokiri Forest key art (thumb-1920-1414762.png).
